title: "simstim host stop"

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Stop the host through its provider or provider script (a VM's sessions stop too; a sandbox's are paused)

```text
simstim host stop <name> [flags]
```

```text

```
